project.name: 城市运行态势监测平台

intentProfile.routingReason: 用户上传智慧城市监测大屏参考图并要求按该设计制作大屏

project.visualSpecExcerpt: Deep navy/black background large-screen dashboard. Top center: angular tech header with main title '城市运行态势监测平台' and subtitle '交通 · 环境 · 能耗 · 安全', flanked by metallic angular decorative borders. Three-column body: left panel traffic metrics (circular cyan car icon, '交通流量 92.6万次', magenta circular gauge '1.28' congestion index, '46km/h' avg speed, 24h area chart), center 3D holographic cityscape with glowing skyscrapers and magenta/cyan traffic arteries encircling, right panel environmental metrics ('空气质量 优' badge, 'PM2.5 28μg/m³', vertical bar + circular gauge '42dB' noise, 24h noise area chart). Bottom row: four hexagonal-icon indicator cards — '能耗 1,280吨标煤', '事件预警 36起', '摄像头在线 98.2%', '工单处理 96.7%'. Color palette: electric blue #00d4ff, magenta #ff00a0/#ff6b9d, cyan accents on near-black #050b1a. HUD/cyberpunk aesthetic with glows, hexagons, grid patterns, particle effects.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Full-screen fixed dark navy/black background (#050b1a) filling the entire dashboard viewport with no scroll, a true large-screen data layout.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: Set body and root containers to background #050b1a, fixed full-viewport (100vw/100vh) dashboard shell with overflow hidden, internal sections fill the viewport.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Top center angular tech header with main title '城市运行态势监测平台' in large bright text and subtitle '交通 · 环境 · 能耗 · 安全' below it, flanked by metallic angular decorative corner brackets.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: Header bar with CSS clip-path/angular borders, large title (var(--sc-fs-display)) in cyan-to-white gradient text, subtitle in secondary text color with dot separators, decorative angled border elements on both sides using borders/clip-path.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Three-column body: left traffic panel, center 3D city visualization, right environment panel. Panels are translucent dark cards with cyan glowing borders and corner accents.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: CSS grid with three columns (left ~24%, center ~52%, right ~24%); each panel uses var(--sc-bg-panel) background, var(--sc-border-cyan) border, subtle glow, and decorative corner brackets via pseudo-elements.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Left panel: circular cyan-ringed car icon, '交通流量 92.6万次' large digital number in cyan, magenta circular gauge showing '1.28' with '拥堵指数' label, '46km/h' avg speed, and a 24-hour area/line chart of speed fluctuations.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: Panel header with circular icon badge (cyan ring), big digital metric value using var(--sc-font-digital) in cyan, a CSS conic-gradient circular gauge with magenta fill and center value '1.28', secondary '46km/h' stat, and a Chart.js area chart (cyan translucent fill) with 00:00-24:00 axis.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Center: glowing holographic 3D cityscape with translucent blue skyscrapers of varying heights, tallest in middle, encircled by sweeping magenta/purple/cyan traffic light arteries, small hexagonal monitoring markers floating above.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: CSS/SVG composition: a central circular stage with radial gradient glow, a skyline built from stacked translucent blue rectangles with window dots, sweeping curved traffic arteries as SVG paths with magenta/cyan gradient strokes and blur glow, a few hexagonal marker badges positioned above buildings. Use transform perspective for depth.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Right panel: circular '优' (Excellent) green badge for air quality with '空气质量 优' and 'PM2.5 28μg/m³'; noise section with vertical bar gauge + circular gauge showing '42dB' and a 24-hour noise area chart.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: Air quality circular badge with green (#00ffa6) ring and '优' center text, metric labels; noise block with a vertical gradient bar gauge, a conic-gradient circular gauge center '42dB', and a Chart.js area chart (magenta/cyan tint) for 24h noise trend.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Bottom row: four rectangular indicator cards with hexagonal icons — 能耗 1,280吨标煤 (building icon), 事件预警 36起 (shield+check), 摄像头在线 98.2% (gear), 工单处理 96.7% (document).
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: Four-column grid of cards with hexagon-shaped icon badges (clip-path polygon), large digital values in var(--sc-font-digital), unit labels, subtle cyan border and glow. Icons rendered as inline SVG or CSS shapes.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Consistent HUD aesthetic: cyan glowing borders, corner brackets, grid/particle background texture, hexagonal motifs, and digital-style numeric typography throughout.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: Apply var(--sc-glow-cyan) to borders/key elements, add corner bracket pseudo-elements on panels, faint CSS grid background pattern on root, use var(--sc-font-digital) for all large numbers.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Color rhythm: cyan as primary accent for neutral/positive data, magenta/pink for congestion/warning emphasis, green for excellent status, deep blue for structure.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: Use --sc-cyan for primary metrics/borders, --sc-magenta for congestion/warning values, --sc-success for air quality excellent, --sc-text-secondary for labels, maintain consistent color semantics across all panels.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Numeric values use a distinct digital/techno font, large and glowing, contrasting with smaller sans-serif Chinese labels.
restoreVisualCheckpoints.targetImplementation: All key metric numbers use var(--sc-font-digital) at --sc-fs-h1 or larger with text-shadow glow; Chinese labels use var(--sc-font-sans) at --sc-fs-body/caption in --sc-text-secondary.

similarityFreeze: Deep navy/black background with cyan/magenta HUD aesthetic
Top angular tech header with main title + subtitle
Three-column layout: traffic left, 3D city center, environment right

交通 · 环境 · 能耗 · 安全

project.designRead: 城市级指挥大屏 / 领导驾驶舱 / 高密度信息展示 / 科技感HUD视觉 / 长时间观看需克制装饰

designSource.designDecisionSummary: 从参考截图还原智慧城市监测大屏：深蓝黑底 + 青/品红HUD配色，三栏布局 + 底部指标卡，数字字体 + 发光边框，3D城市用CSS/SVG近似。

pages.title: 城市运行态势监测平台
pages.businessScenario: 智慧城市运行态势监测大屏，展示交通、环境、能耗、安全四大维度指标
pages.visualNorthStar: 深空黑底上的科技感城市指挥大屏，中央3D城市数字孪生为核心视觉，两侧数据面板与底部指标卡呈对称包围结构
pages.compositionPattern: 三栏包围式：顶部标题栏 + 左交通/中城市/右环境 + 底部四指标卡
qualityRisks: 大屏固定视口布局需精确控制尺寸
高密度信息需保持留白节奏

绿色圆形优徽章 + PM2.5 + 竖条仪表 + 青色圆形42dB仪表 + Chart.js品红噪声面积图
四列六边形图标卡，Lucide图标 zap/shield/video/clipboard，大数字发光

数字 var(--sc-font-digital) 发光，中文标签 var(--sc-font-sans) 次要色
